recommendation: Keep this fix; it synchronizes generated primitive profile descriptions with the already-published datatype page wording and requires no behavior or regex change.
issue_request: FHIR-16948 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for FHIR-core datatypes. It asked whether seconds in dateTime and time may always be ignored or only when zero-filled, and the accepted resolution was to clarify that ignoring seconds is up to the receiver.
initial_application: Commit 4479281e5a (GF#16948/SVN r14283) updated source/datatypes.html for dateTime and time to say seconds may be ignored at receiver discretion; that wording remains present on the current datatype narrative page.
additional_context: The primitive spreadsheet source still used the older dateTime sentence and, after the FHIR-5871 source fix, the older time sentence. This source feeds generated datetime.profile.json and time.profile.json descriptions, so the generated primitive profiles were not aligned with the applied narrative table.
reconciliation: Changed source/datatypes/primitives.xml so both dateTime and time primitive descriptions include 'at receiver discretion.'
source_changes: source/datatypes/primitives.xml: added 'at receiver discretion' to the dateTime primitive description.
source/datatypes/primitives.xml: added 'at receiver discretion' to the time primitive description.

related_jiras.note: Introduced the required-seconds wording that FHIR-16948 later clarified.
